use_case: Use the estimate request form during deficiency capture, assignment, and verification when the punch list record must identify room or grid location, system, responsible trade, contract reference, and turnover milestone. Complete the applicable handoff for verified correction, owner acceptance, exception disposition, remaining-list reconciliation, and turnover handoff.
